args.body: For CATALOGUE-CHECKOUT-ACTIVATION-HANDOFF, use the completed checkout-fit verdict and read the actual files for the exact download named in the proposed listing. Reuse existing clean-delivery evidence if it covers those exact bytes. If checkout qualifies, make the packet executable for the operator: provide the exact sale inventory and hashes, copy-ready listing, one documented fee example, seller activation prerequisites, and the receipt evidence needed to distinguish a paid order from a settled payout. If an advertised deliverable is missing or unsupported, narrow the listing to the verified package. If the route was excluded, close on the controlling evidence and precise reopening trigger. Read the saved packet before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. No account creation, external contact, spend or publication.

description: Treasury reports no verified funds or revenue. Available feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand and experiment attribution remain unknown. The next commercial step is to turn the existing catalogue work into a concrete purchase decision. Verify what a buyer would receive, finish the checkout activation handoff, and keep marketplace discovery and settlement separate. The referral pilot still requires an operator send-or-decline decision. Revisit it when that decision is recorded or an eligible inquiry arrives.
